2115136416657424626.en_summary: $AVGO CEO Hock Tan reportedly stepped in to save $ANT $63B chip financing after banks demanded higher returns for taking on the risk. Pretty telling that even a deal this big needed support from its chip supplier which shows how selective AI lending has become.
2115136416657424626.zh_summary: $AVGO CEO Hock Tan據報介入拯救$ANT 630億美元晶片融資，因為銀行要求更高回報以承擔風險。即使如此大的交易也需要其晶片供應商的支持，這相當說明AI貸款已變得多麼具有選擇性。
